title: Require Runtime Realization Lab Source Relationships
forbids: a literal module-loading edge that reverses Oracle isolation, lets scenarios acquire Lab internals, lets any Lab source acquire parent-repository product code, or imports raw Effect outside the admitted SDK, runtime, Oracle, vendor, and vendor-test lanes
why: The Lab must remain a contained proof environment. Shared and Reference Runtime source stay independent of the Oracle, scenarios author only through local public aliases, raw Effect mechanics stay behind the Lab's admitted runtime lanes, and no Lab source becomes an executable backdoor into parent-repository products.
remediate: Keep Oracle dependencies one-way, consume Lab capabilities from scenarios through @rawr/sdk or @rawr/spec-env, keep raw Effect mechanics in the admitted SDK/runtime/vendor lanes, and pass parent-repository behavior through separately owned migration work rather than importing apps, packages, services, or plugins.
message: Runtime Realization Lab source relationships must preserve plane isolation and parent-repository containment.
